name: PFC Jones
summary: A Jones appears three times in Larry's 2026-08-15 identifications: he believes the crewman working at the rotor head in VN-0012 is PFC Jones; he names the white-T-shirted man climbing into the Huey in VN-0020 as PFC Jones; and Sarge the monkey (VN-0017) may have belonged to "Jones, the helicopter pilot." Whether the PFC crewman and "the helicopter pilot" are one man loosely described or two different Joneses is unresolved. On 2026-09-05, looking at VN-0071 — a view of paddies through a helicopter door on the run from Tân Sơn Nhứt to the mountain — Larry added an event: "PFC Jones and I got shot down and had to go back to the base and land one time. That is what PFC Jones was looking at in the picture."
researchNotes: An enlisted crew chief would fit both the rotor-head maintenance work (VN-0012) and climbing into the Huey (VN-0020); crew chiefs flew, which could explain a loose 'helicopter pilot' description. Jones is too common for a blind roster search — needs the unit settled first, or a first name from Larry. Ask whether there was one Jones or two. 2026-09-05 (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0071-c18307913.json): a shoot-down that ended in a return to base is a documented kind of event — an aircraft taking hits generated a report, and a damaged airframe a maintenance record — and it is the first incident attached to a Jones rather than a likeness. Undated; the frame he attached it to is the Rosethorn 007 run to Núi Bà Đen. Ledger #34, issue #130.
